            color_identity, image_uris, set_code, collector_number, released_at, layout, rarity, game_changer,
            commander_legal, can_be_commander, commander_pairing, inserted_at, updated_at)

            color_identity, image_uris, set_code, collector_number, released_at, layout, rarity, game_changer,
            commander_legal, can_be_commander, commander_pairing, inserted_at, updated_at
